about: Prompt for the video model, filled per pose from item.json. Phrases that trip video model safety filters are avoided on purpose (see README).
lines: {{subject}}, seen exactly from the side in profile, facing {{facing}} the whole time.

camera.locomotion: Side tracking shot: the camera travels alongside at exactly the same speed, so the figure stays in the centre of the frame and moves in place with its full motion.
camera.loop: Static camera, locked off: no pan, no zoom, no camera movement.
camera.transition: Static camera, locked off: no pan, no zoom, no camera movement.
camera.reaction: Static camera, locked off: no pan, no zoom, no camera movement.

details: These details stay in every frame until the very end, never fading or disappearing: {{list}}.
